hero.title: Little Books {for} Big Imaginations
hero.paragraph: We are one family, a kitchen table and a shelf of stories read aloud at bedtime for three generations. The books that were passed down to us are now yours to pass on.
hero.caption: Hand-picked stories

howItWorks.heading: Three small steps to bedtime
howItWorks.sub: No accounts, no carts, no fuss. Just a shelf, a first page and a message to us.

steps.title: Browse the shelf
steps.text: Drag along the spines, filter by age or theme, and tap any cover that catches your eye. Every book shows its pages, reading time and price up front.

steps.title: Read the first page
steps.text: Peek inside before you decide. We put the whole first page online so you can hear how a story sounds out loud before it ever reaches your bedside table.

steps.title: Order in a message
steps.text: Found the one? Send us a WhatsApp or an email with the title. We wrap it in brown paper, write the name on the card and post it the next morning.

shelf.heading: Pull the shelf. Tap a book.
shelf.sub: Ten hardcovers, each one here because it was still asked for on the second night.
shelf.hint: Drag to browse · tap a book to peek inside
shelf.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, author or theme
shelf.empty: No book matches that yet — try another word.

peek.heading: Peek inside
peek.sub: The first page of every book, exactly as it reads on paper. Try it out loud and see if the room goes quiet.

ages.heading: The right story for the right age
ages.sub: Every book carries an age band, but these are starting points rather than rules. Children who are read to often reach a little higher.

bands.label: Ages 3–5
bands.text: Short sentences, big pictures and plenty of repetition to join in with. Stories that settle rather than stir, finished in one sitting before the eyes close.

bands.label: Ages 5–7
bands.text: Longer tales with a proper middle, a question to wonder about and words that are fun in the mouth. Good for early readers sharing the page with a grown-up.

bands.label: Ages 6–8
bands.text: Real adventures with a bit of weather in them. Braver characters, trickier choices and endings worth talking about on the walk to school the next morning.

about.heading: A shelf that started in a kitchen
paragraphs: StoryTime began with our grandmother's shelf: a dozen books so well read that the spines had gone soft as cloth. She read them to our mother, our mother read them to us, and now we read them to our own children. Somewhere along the way we started writing new ones.

Every book here is one we read at home first. If it is not asked for again on the second night, it does not make the shelf. We print in small runs on thick matte paper that stands up to jam and sticky fingers, and we post every parcel ourselves from the same kitchen table.

order.heading: Order with a message
order.sub: There is no checkout here. Tell us which book you would like and we will reply the same day with the price, postage and when it will arrive.
order.note: We post within two working days. Add the child's name to your message and we will write it inside the front cover for free.
